department.instructions: Classify the primary routing department for this incoming customer or system event.

criteria.billing: Invoices, duplicate charges, refunds, payment failures, subscription pricing, or tax receipts
criteria.technical: Software bugs, API errors, gateway timeouts, crashes, stack traces, or infrastructure outages
criteria.security: Phishing, unauthorized access, compromised credentials, 2FA/MFA bypass, or prompt injection attacks
criteria.account: Profile settings, SSO configuration, user seat permissions, role changes, or login username updates

urgency.instructions: Score the operational urgency and severity of this event from 0 (low) to 3 (critical emergency).
criteria: 0: Informational note, feedback, or low-priority archive item requiring no immediate action
1: Routine request or standard support inquiry within normal SLA
2: Time-sensitive business issue or billing dispute needing prompt follow-up
3: Critical production outage, active security breach, or immediate churn threat

requires_escalation.instructions: Does this event require immediate supervisor or security escalation due to critical outage, active fraud/phishing, or churn threat?
criteria: false: Standard routine request that can be handled by automated tier-1 workflows
true: Urgent escalation required due to critical outage, security compromise, or customer threatening to cancel
